faq.q: Can I check fashion boutique stock before I come?
faq.a: Yes. Send us a message and we will confirm what is available before you make the trip. It is the same for kurtis and suits as it is for sarees.

faq.q: What if I am unsure about sarees?
faq.a: Ask us. We explain the differences in plain words and let you decide in your own time. That goes for designer wear and lehengas too.

faq.q: Do you offer delivery for lehengas?
faq.a: Ask us about your area and we will tell you plainly what is possible. Ask us about dupattas and accessories or fitting help and the answer is the same.

faq.q: Can I ask about returns on kurtis and suits?
faq.a: Yes. Ask before you buy and we will explain how returns or exchanges work for the item. The same approach applies to sarees and fitting help.

faq.q: Do you take special requests for dupattas and accessories?
faq.a: Tell us what you are looking for; if we cannot get it, we will say so honestly. This applies to sarees, kurtis and suits and the rest of our fashion boutique work.
